999008199.text: できた！　鉱物探知機ー！

localizations.en: I did it! A mineral detector!

999008199.text: それが探索に役立つ道具なの？

うん。錬金術でよく使う鉱物の成分に
反応するようにできてるんだよ

localizations.en: Yep. It's designed to react to mineral components commonly used in alchemy.

999008199.text:
実際に掘り返す手間もなく地下の様子を
調べられるんだから、役に立つでしょ？

localizations.en: It lets you survey what's underground without actually having to dig it up, so it'll definitely come in handy, right?

999008199.text:
確かに……穴を掘るのって
単純労働でキツいし面白くないんだよね

localizations.en: No doubt about it... Digging holes is hard labor, boring, and exhausting.

999008199.text:
うん、すごく便利そう。
というわけで、私のお題も合格！

localizations.en: Yeah, it looks really useful. It's a pass in my books!

999008199.text:
えへへ、やった！
課題を達成していくの、気持ちいいね！

localizations.en: Yippee! Overcoming challenges does feel great!

999008199.text:
あらあら、やる気ね。逞しくて好きよ。
それじゃあ次はどの難所踏破のお題を出そうかしら？

localizations.en: My, my, look at you, all fired up. I love that tenacity. Now then, which hazardous trial should I have you tackle next?

999008199.text: ……え？　まだあるの？

近くの島にある難所、見繕ってあるわよ。
酸の湖と命綱無しの奇岩渡り、どちらがいい？

localizations.en: I've picked out some hazardous areas on nearby islands. An acid lake or crossing jagged rocks without safety lines—which would you prefer?

999008199.text: ……まだ、酸のほうかな
ヤンネさん、容赦がありませんね。素敵です

localizations.en: Janne, you show no mercy. How lovely.

999008199.text:
カロリンさんも十分容赦ないとは思うけど……
ヤンネさんのシゴキも聖戦士仕込みだもんね

localizations.en: I'd say Caroline's pretty merciless herself... But yeah, Janne's drills are straight out of the Sacred Knights' playbook.

999008199.text:
でも、この厳しい特訓を最後までやり遂げたら、
アルビーナも絶対に自信がついちゃうよね

localizations.en: Still, if Alvina makes it through all this tough training, she'll definitely gain the needed confidence, right?

999008199.text: それは確かにね……

そして近くの難所をすべて踏破できたら
今度は人数を少なくして再挑戦よ

localizations.en: And once you've cleared all the nearby hazards, we'll reduce the party size and try them again.

999008199.text: 高難易度も用意されてる……！

新しい場所にばかり冒険に行っていたら
毎回、緊張してしまうでしょう？

localizations.en: If you only venture to new places, you'll be tense every single time, won't you?

999008199.text:
そうですね。勝手知ったる土地で修行をするのも
いいと思います。緊張感が皆無になっても困りますが

localizations.en: Indeed. While training on familiar ground is a good idea, we don't want you getting too comfortable either.

999008199.text:
大丈夫。冒険って聞いて心臓バクバクしてるから。
ワクワクより、ドキドキのほうが今はまだ正直強い……

localizations.en: Don't worry. Just hearing the word 'adventure' makes my heart race. Honestly though, I think that's because it's more that it's nerve-wracking than exciting...

999008199.text:
でも、いくら危険な難所でも暗黒の氷海よりは
怖くないはずだから……

localizations.en: But no matter how dangerous these trials are, they can't be scarier than the Midnight Sea...

999008199.text:
いきなり熱いお風呂には入れないので
徐々に身体を慣らすような感じですね？

localizations.en: You can't jump straight into a scalding bath, so it's like gradually getting your body used to the heat?

999008199.text:
独特なたとえだけど……
まあそんな感じだと、思う

localizations.en: That's an... interesting comparison, but... yeah, I guess it's something like that.

999008199.text:
シゴキはキツいけど
ヤンネさんのこと、信じてるから。これからもお願いね

localizations.en: The drills are tough, but I trust you both, so please keep it up.

999008199.text:
ふふっ、任せて。
神聖国の鬼教官と呼ばれた実力、見せてあげる

localizations.en: Hehe, leave it to me. I'll show you the skills that earned me the title of Nova's demon instructor.

999008199.text:
……できれば、やっぱり少しは
お手柔らかにお願いしたいかも

localizations.en: ...Okay... maybe you could maybe go a little easier on me?
